text.title: 布瑞尔的补给
text.objectives: 将莫里斯的订单交给蝙蝠管理员安内特。
text.description: 执行官塞加德让我清查我们在布瑞尔的装备。由于森林中潜伏着的天灾军团士兵的威胁，他不希望亡灵卫兵们在装备方面有所短缺。$B$B我发现，我们的武器储备大体上还算齐整，但是我们仍然需要更多的武器来替换那些在战场上丢失的武器。$B$B这是一份武器订单，把它交给幽暗城里的武器供应商高顿·温德哈姆。带着订单去找我们的蝙蝠管理员安内特，跟她谈谈关于前往幽暗城的事儿吧。
text.progress: You appear to be on official business...
text.completion: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for Brill must not be left under stocked.

english.title: Supplying Brill
english.objectives: Bring Morris's Order to Bat Handler Anette.
english.description: Executor Zygand asked me to take stock of our equipment here in Brill.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.$B$BI found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.$B$BHere is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to Bat Handler Anette and speak with her about transport to the Undercity.
english.progress: You appear to be on official business...
english.completion: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for Brill must not be left under stocked.

text.title: 迈克尔·加勒特
text.objectives: 将高顿的箱子交给迈克尔·加勒特。
text.description: 我已经将布瑞尔那边要求的物资装箱了。如果你已经拜访过布瑞尔，并与他们那里的蝙蝠管理员打过招呼，那么你就可以乘坐蝙蝠回到那儿去。$B$B与幽暗城的蝙蝠饲养员迈克尔·加勒特谈谈吧，他可以为你提供一只飞往布瑞尔的蝙蝠。
text.progress: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
text.completion: This crate must reach Brill quickly?  That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.

english.title: Michael Garrett
english.objectives: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
english.description: I have placed Brill's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited Brill and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to her.$B$BSpeak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to Brill.
english.progress: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
english.completion: This crate must reach Brill quickly?  That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.

text.title: 飞往幽暗城
text.objectives: 从蝙蝠管理员安内特那里弄一只蝙蝠飞往幽暗城，然后将莫里斯的订单交给幽暗城里的高顿·温德哈姆。
text.description: 我的蝙蝠就可以把你带到幽暗城去。通常我都会收一点小钱，不过对于你这样$g帅气:可爱;的$r，自然就是免费了。当你准备就绪时再来找我，然后我会帮你安排剩下的事情。$B$B你可以在幽暗城的贸易区里找到高顿·温德哈姆，那也是我的蝙蝠降落的区域。
text.progress: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
text.completion: An order from Brill?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.

english.title: Ride to the Undercity
english.objectives: Request a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Bat Handler Anette, then take Morris's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
english.description: One of my bats can take you to the Undercity.  Normally these flights require a small fee, but the flight to Undercity is complimentary for a $g handsome: lovely; $r like you.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.$B$BYou will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
english.progress: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
english.completion: An order from Brill?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.

text.title: 向莫里斯回报
text.objectives: 从蝙蝠管理员迈克尔·加勒特那儿租一只蝙蝠飞往布瑞尔，然后将高顿的箱子交给布瑞尔的亡灵卫兵莫里斯。
text.description: 布瑞尔的蝙蝠管理员是安内特。如果你们已经见过面，那么我可以为你提供一只返回她那儿去的蝙蝠。$B$B这些蝙蝠都可以直飞幽暗城，但是如果你想要飞到更遥远的地方去，就必须先拜访那个区域的蝙蝠饲养员。$B$B你已经在布瑞尔跟安内特碰过面了，现在你可以乘坐蝙蝠回布瑞尔了。当你准备就绪时再来找我吧。
text.progress: $N, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
text.completion: Good work, $N.  These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.$B$BYou have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.

english.title: Return to Morris
english.objectives: Buy a bat ride to Brill from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Morris in Brill.
english.description: The bat master in Brill is Bat Handler Anette.  If you have already met her, then I can give you a bat to fly back to her.$B$BOur bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.$B$BYou have met Anette in Brill, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
english.progress: $N, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
english.completion: Good work, $N.  These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.$B$BYou have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.

text.title: 前往达纳苏斯
text.objectives: 与菲德利奥交谈，租用角鹰兽飞往达纳苏斯，然后将多兰纳尔的食谱书交给达纳苏斯的艾奎恩妮。
text.description: 多兰纳尔的每个人都为艾奎恩妮感到骄傲。我敢说，当她收到这件奈欧玛精心准备的礼物时，一定会非常开心的。$B$B等你准备前往达纳苏斯的时候，就告诉我一声，只需要区区几枚铜板，你就可以租一只角鹰兽飞往那里。我听说艾奎恩妮很喜欢在一处小广场上独自冥想，那地方就在达纳苏斯的角鹰兽管理员南边。抵达之后就去那里找她吧。
text.progress: How may I help you?
text.completion: Something for me? I wonder who sent it...

english.title: To Darnassus
english.objectives: Speak to Fidelio to purchase a flight to Darnassus, then bring the Dolanaar Recipe Book to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
english.description: Everyone in Dolanaar is so proud of Sister Aquinne. I'm certain she'll be pleased to receive this thoughtful gift from Nyoma.$B$BWhen you're ready to travel to Darnassus, just speak to me again and for a few coins, you can hire a hippogryph to take you there. I'm told Sister Aquinne enjoys the solitude of a small plaza just south of the hippogryph master in Darnassus. Look for her there after you arrive.
english.progress: How may I help you?
english.completion: Something for me? I wonder who sent it...

text.title: 意外的礼物
text.objectives: 将艾奎恩妮的笔记交给达纳苏斯的角鹰兽管理员利奥拉。
text.description: 太棒了！当我在月神殿里修行的时候，正需要这样一件东西来寄托思乡之情。我今晚就试试书上记载的食谱，简直等不及啦！$B$B你能把这封简短的感谢信带回去交给奈欧玛吗？你可以租用一只角鹰兽飞回多兰纳尔，只要去找我们的角鹰兽管理员利奥拉就行了。她会帮你安排飞回多兰纳尔的行程。
text.progress: Are you ready to return to Dolanaar?
text.completion: Do you need a ride back to Dolanaar?

english.title: An Unexpected Gift
english.objectives: Bring Sister Aquinne's Note to Leora, the hippogryph master in Darnassus.
english.description: This is wonderful! It's just the kind of thing I need to remind me of home while I continue my studies in the Temple of the Moon. I'll try out one of the recipes tonight. I can't wait!$B$BWould you take this short note of thanks back to Nyoma? You can hire a hippogryph to take you back to Dolanaar. Just visit our hippogryph master, Leora, when you're ready to leave. She'll help you get a ride back to Dolanaar.
english.progress: Are you ready to return to Dolanaar?
english.completion: Do you need a ride back to Dolanaar?

text.title: 返回奈欧玛身边
text.objectives: 与利奥拉交谈，租用角鹰兽飞回多兰纳尔。当你抵达多兰纳尔之后，将艾奎恩妮的笔记交给奈欧玛。
text.description: 要安排你飞回多兰纳尔很容易。既然你已经见过多兰纳尔的菲德利奥了，就可以直接飞回去。$B$B当你抵达新的城镇时，记得去跟当地的飞行管理员打个招呼，这样你就可以使用那里的飞行服务了。$B$B等你准备租用角鹰兽返回多兰纳尔的时候，就告诉我一声。
text.progress: $N, you're back from Darnassus?
text.completion: It sounds like she loved it. Thank you for bringing the book to Sister Aquinne, $N. One of these days, I intend to take her up on her invitation to visit her in Darnassus.

english.title: Return to Nyoma
english.objectives: Speak to Leora to hire a hippogryph to take you back to Dolanaar. Once you've arrived in Dolanaar, take Sister Aquinne's Note to Nyoma.
english.description: It will be easy to get you a flight back to Dolanaar. Since you already know Fidelio in Dolanaar, you'll be able to fly back there without any problems.$B$BWhenever you arrive in a new town, you should remember to speak to the flight master so that you can fly to and from the new location.$B$BSpeak with me when you're ready to hire a hippogryph to return to Dolanaar.
english.progress: $N, you're back from Darnassus?
english.completion: It sounds like she loved it. Thank you for bringing the book to Sister Aquinne, $N. One of these days, I intend to take her up on her invitation to visit her in Darnassus.

text.title: 睹物思乡
text.objectives: 将多兰纳尔的食谱书交给多兰纳尔的菲德利奥。
text.description: 我的一位朋友，艾奎恩妮，正在达纳苏斯接受成为月之女祭司的必要训练。她去年就离开多兰纳尔前往神殿了，她在信中说自己进展顺利，学到了许多东西，但是她非常想念家里和老朋友。所以呢，我给她准备了一本书，里面记载着她喜欢的各种多兰纳尔食品的食谱。$B$B如果你有时间的话，能帮我把它带到达纳苏斯去交给她吗？你可以从菲德利奥那里租一只角鹰兽。他就在镇子中间，从旅店穿过去就是。
text.progress: How can I help you?
text.completion: That's very thoughtful of Nyoma. For a few coins, I can arrange quick transportation to the capital by hippogryph.

english.title: Reminders of Home
english.objectives: Bring the Dolanaar Recipe Book to Fidelio in Dolanaar.
english.description: A friend of mine, Sister Aquinne, is training to be a priestess of the moon in Darnassus.  She left Dolanaar to study in the temple last year. Her letters say she is doing well and learning much, but she misses home and her old friends. I've put together a book of her favorite recipes from Dolanaar.$B$BIf you have time, would you take them to her in Darnassus? You can rent a hippogryph from Fidelio. He's in the center of town, just across from the inn.
english.progress: How can I help you?
english.completion: That's very thoughtful of Nyoma. For a few coins, I can arrange quick transportation to the capital by hippogryph.

text.title: 一捆兽皮
text.objectives: 带着兽皮去找血蹄村的双足飞龙管理员塔克。
text.description: 我有一捆在莫高雷采集的兽皮，必须要把它们送到雷霆崖去。我在那儿的同伴安哈努需要用这些兽皮来制作皮件。$B$B你能帮我把这些兽皮交给他吗？$B$B前往雷霆崖最为快捷的方法就是乘坐双足飞龙。带着这捆兽皮去找血蹄村的双足飞龙管理员塔克，跟他谈谈到雷霆崖去的事儿。
text.progress: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
text.completion: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you have come to the right place.
text.completed: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: A Bundle of Hides
english.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Tak in Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: I have a bundle of hides from the animals of Mulgore, and must get them to Thunder Bluff.  A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.$B$BWill you take the hides to him for me?$B$BThe quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider.  Bring the bundle of hides to Tak, our wind rider master in Bloodhoof Village, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
english.completion: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you have come to the right place.
english.completed: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 飞往雷霆崖
text.objectives: 从双足飞龙管理员塔克那里租一只双足飞龙前往雷霆崖，然后将这捆兽皮交给雷霆崖的安哈努。
text.description: 只需一小笔费用，我就可以为你提供飞往雷霆崖的双足飞龙。没有比这更方便快捷的旅行方式了！$B$B如果你愿意的话，准备一下就来找我吧。$B$B如果你要把这些兽皮交给安哈努，就到雷霆崖驭风者高塔底层的海瓦的武器店里去找他吧，就是你降落的地方！
text.progress: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from Mulgore.  You have spoken with my friend Varg?
text.completion: Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!$B$BThank you, $Gbrother:sister;. You have done me a great service. Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
text.completed: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff
english.objectives: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Tak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff.  There's no faster way to the city!$B$BIf that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.$B$BIf you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff.  And that's right where you'll land!
english.progress: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from Mulgore.  You have spoken with my friend Varg?
english.completion: Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!$B$BThank you, $Gbrother:sister;. You have done me a great service. Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
english.completed: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 双足飞龙驭手塔尔
text.objectives: 将安哈努的皮货交给雷霆崖的塔尔。
text.description: 我已经为瓦尔格准备好了供他在十字路口出售的皮件。请你把这些交给他好吗？$B$B如果你已经拜访过了血蹄村的双足飞龙管理员，那么你就可以乘坐雷霆崖的双足飞龙返回他那儿了。$B$B将皮件交给雷霆崖的双足飞龙管理员塔尔，然后和他谈谈前往血蹄村的行程安排。
text.progress: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
text.completion: You need to take this to Bloodhoof Village, eh?  That's not a problem.  If you've already been there and spoken to Tak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
text.completed: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master
english.objectives: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: I have prepared leather goods for Varg to sell at the Bloodhoof Village.  Will you bring them to him?$B$BIf you have already been to Bloodhoof Village and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.$B$BTake the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to Bloodhoof Village.
english.progress: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
english.completion: You need to take this to Bloodhoof Village, eh?  That's not a problem.  If you've already been there and spoken to Tak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
english.completed: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 向瓦尔格复命
text.objectives: 从双足飞龙管理员塔尔那里租用一头飞往血蹄村的双足飞龙，并把安哈努的皮货交给瓦尔格·风语。
text.description: 想要飞回某座城镇的话，你必须已经徒步到达过那里，并且和那里的双足飞龙管理员打过招呼。既然你已经去过血蹄村，并和他们的双足飞龙管理员塔尔谈过话，那么你就可以从这里搭乘双足飞龙直接飞过去了。$B$B如果你准备好了，就再次和我谈谈。到了血蹄村之后，把这些皮货交给瓦尔格·风语。
text.progress: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
text.completion:
Ahanu sent me finished products?  Very good.  There are many hunters and adventurers in Bloodhoof Village now and business is lively.  I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

Thank you for all your efforts, $N.  I am in your debt.
text.completed: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

english.title: Return to Varg
english.objectives: Buy a wind rider to Bloodhoof Village from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Varg Whisperwind.
english.description: In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Bloodhoof Village and spoken to their wind rider master Tak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.$B$BSpeak with me again when you are ready.  Once at Bloodhoof Village, you can then deliver the leather goods to Varg Whisperwind.
english.progress: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
english.completion:
Ahanu sent me finished products?  Very good.  There are many hunters and adventurers in Bloodhoof Village now and business is lively.  I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

Thank you for all your efforts, $N.  I am in your debt.
english.completed: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

text.title: 送往奥格瑞玛的肉
text.objectives: 把格瑞姆塔克的肉品交给剃刀岭的波洛克。
text.description: 我有一些上等的肉片想送给我的朋友。她的名字叫雷什卡，是奥格瑞玛旅店的老板。你可以替我把这些肉交给她吗？$B$B到奥格瑞玛去的最快捷方法就是乘坐双足飞龙。带着这些肉去找剃刀岭的双足飞龙管理员波洛克，跟他谈谈关于到奥格瑞玛去的事情。
text.progress: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right orc!
text.completion: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
text.completed: Bring Zargh's Meats to to Burok at Razor Hill.

english.title: Meats to Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Bring Grimtak's Meats to Burok in Razor Hill.
english.description: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend.  Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar.  Will you deliver the meat for me?$B$BThe fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider.  Take the meats to the Razor Hill wind rider master, Burok, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.
english.progress: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right orc!
english.completion: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
english.completed: Bring Zargh's Meats to to Burok at Razor Hill.

text.title: New Life
text.objectives: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
text.description: As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.$B$B$n, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
text.progress: These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.$b$bHave you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
text.completion: This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.$b$bOnly then $N, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.$b$bYou have done well $C; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.
text.completed: Return to Tammra Windfield at Sunrock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.objectives: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

text.title: The Ashenvale Hunt
text.objectives: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
text.description: Your strength impresses me, $c.  Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.$B$BThe forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually.  If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post.  The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.
text.completion: Welcome to the new frontier, $N.  Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $C like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle.  Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.$B$BYour presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt.  Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

english.objectives: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

text.title: The Ashenvale Hunt
text.completion: There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.$B$BThe creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.

text.title: 飞往奥格瑞玛
text.objectives: 从双足飞龙管理员波洛克那里租一只双足飞龙前往奥格瑞玛，然后将格瑞姆塔克的肉品交给奥格瑞玛的格雷什卡。
text.description: 只需一小笔费用，我就可以为你提供飞往奥格瑞玛的双足飞龙。当你到那儿后，就去把格瑞姆塔克的肉品交给格雷什卡。她的旅店就在力量谷里。$B$B当你准备动身的时候就来找我吧。
text.progress: Something smells good! You don't have raw meat on you, do you?
text.completion: Oh, wonderful! Those are fine cuts! These are from Zargh, are they? That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...$B$BOh, I can't wait to cook it. But not too much! Meat is best served rare, don't you think?
text.completed: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Ride to Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Burok, then bring Grimtak's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
english.description: For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar.  When you get there, you can take Grimtak's meats to Gryshka.  Her inn is in the Valley of Strength.$B$BSpeak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
english.progress: Something smells good! You don't have raw meat on you, do you?
english.completion: Oh, wonderful! Those are fine cuts! These are from Zargh, are they? That orc sure knows his way into a lady's heart...$B$BOh, I can't wait to cook it. But not too much! Meat is best served rare, don't you think?
english.completed: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 双足飞龙驭手多拉斯
text.objectives: 将格雷什卡的信交给奥格瑞玛的多拉斯。
text.description: 我已经为格瑞姆塔克写了一封感谢信。你能帮我交给他吗？如果你已经去过剃刀岭，并且和那里的双足飞龙管理员谈过话，那么你就可以乘坐一头双足飞龙直飞到那里去。$B$B把我的信交给奥格瑞玛的双足飞龙管理员多拉斯，并同他谈谈去剃刀岭的事儿。
text.progress: Do you need one of my wind riders?
text.completion: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? Yes, I can get you there...
text.completed: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Doras the Wind Rider Master
english.objectives: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I've written a letter of thanks to Grimtak.  Will you deliver it for me?  If you've already been to the Razor Hill and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.$B$BTake my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to Razor Hill.
english.progress: Do you need one of my wind riders?
english.completion: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? Yes, I can get you there...
english.completed: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 返回剃刀岭
text.objectives: 从双足飞龙管理员多拉斯那里租一只双足飞龙前往剃刀岭，然后将格雷什卡的信交给剃刀岭的格瑞姆塔克。
text.description: 经过训练，我的双足飞龙可以飞往许多不同的地方，只要你已经去过那个地方，并且与那里的双足飞龙管理员进行了交谈，双足飞龙就可以载着你前往那地方。$B$B你已经去过剃刀岭，也跟那里的双足飞龙饲养员波洛克打过了招呼，所以现在你可以直接飞到他那儿了。一旦你到了剃刀岭，就把格雷什卡的信交给格瑞姆塔克。$B$B当你准备出发时就来找我谈谈。
text.progress: Have you returned from Orgrimmar? Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?
text.completion: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!$B$BThank you, $N. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
text.completed: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

english.title: Return to Razor Hill
english.objectives: Buy a wind rider to Razor Hill from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Grimtak at Razor Hill.
english.description: My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.$B$BYou have been to Razor Hill and spoken to their wind rider master Burok, so now you can fly directly to him from here.  Once you're at Razor Hill, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Grimtak.$B$BSpeak with me when you are ready to go.
english.progress: Have you returned from Orgrimmar? Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?
english.completion: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!$B$BThank you, $N. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
english.completed: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

text.title: 荣誉学员
text.objectives: 将格雷姆罗克的名单交给卡拉诺斯的布洛兰·风须。
text.description: 我看见门前聚集了一大群年轻的矮人，他们都迫切地想要学习烹饪技巧。如果说有一件东西是厨师最需要的工具的话，那当然是菜刀无疑了！$B$B我有一张厨艺优秀的学生名单，他们都将获得一把荣誉菜刀。把这张名单交给铁炉堡的高尼尔·石趾，他会为你准备好菜刀的。$B$B去铁炉堡最快的途径是乘坐狮鹫，带着这张名单去找狮鹫管理员布洛兰·风须吧，跟他谈谈去铁炉堡的事儿。
text.progress: Have you had your fill of Kharanos so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
text.completion: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh?  For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there.  How does that sound?

english.title: Honor Students
english.objectives: Bring Gremlock's List to Brolan Galebeard in Kharanos.
english.description: I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of cooking.  And if there's one thing a cook needs more than anything, it's a cleaver!$B$BI have a list of students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary cleaver.  Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.  He'll get the cleavers ready.$B$BThe fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Brolan Galebeard, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.
english.progress: Have you had your fill of Kharanos so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
english.completion: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh?  For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there.  How does that sound?

text.title: 格莱斯·瑟登
text.objectives: 将荣誉菜刀交给铁炉堡的格莱斯·瑟登。
text.description: 这是给格雷姆罗克的学生的荣誉菜刀。如果你已经去过卡拉诺斯了，就乘坐狮鹫返回那里吧！$B$B把这些荣誉菜刀交给狮鹫管理员格莱斯·瑟登，跟他谈谈关于返回卡拉诺斯的事儿。
text.progress: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
text.completion: You have to get these to Kharanos, eh?  That won't be a problem.  As long as you've already been to Kharanos and spoken to Brolan Galebeard, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.

english.title: Gryth Thurden
english.objectives: Bring the Honorary Cleavers to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.
english.description: Here are the honorary cleavers for Gremlock's students.  If you've already been to Kharanos, then you should fly a gryphon back there!$B$BTake the cleavers to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Kharanos.
english.progress: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
english.completion: You have to get these to Kharanos, eh?  That won't be a problem.  As long as you've already been to Kharanos and spoken to Brolan Galebeard, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.

text.title: A Plague Upon Thee
text.objectives: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
text.description: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.$B$BYou set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
text.progress: Have you done it, $N? Have you released the termites? The Light help us if the Scarlet Crusade were able to hold onto both the mill and Hearthglen. They should have neither. They're just capitalizing on the victims of the last war and should be put down like rabid animals!
text.completion: Haha! Thank you, $N! You've done it! My father's spirit can now rest and I can live in peace.$B$BThank you again. If there is anything I can do for you, please, just ask.
text.completed: Return to to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

english.completed: Return to to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: A Plague Upon Thee
text.objectives: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
text.description: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.$B$BYou set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
text.progress: Have you done it, $N? Have you released the termites in the lumber mill?$B$BIt was bad enough that my family lost their jobs and lives, but then to see the place where my childhood was spent taken over by those disgusting so-called holy men... pfah!!
text.completion: Thank you, $N. Here, take this coin. I'm sorry it's not more, but try to take some joy in helping destroy the Scarlet Crusade's efforts!
text.completed: Return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 飞往铁炉堡
text.objectives: 从狮鹫管理员布洛兰·风须那里租一只狮鹫飞往铁炉堡，然后将格雷姆罗克的名单交给铁炉堡的高尼尔·石趾。
text.description: 只需一小笔费用，我就能为你提供一只飞往铁炉堡的狮鹫，让你把格雷姆罗克的名单交给高尼尔·石趾。你可以在铁炉堡大锻炉区的深山矿工协会里找到他，狮鹫也会在那个区域降落！$B$B当你准备出发时就来找我。
text.progress: What can I do for you, $gsir:my lady;?
text.completion: Ah, the latest list of Gremlock's best pupils.  I have a batch of honorary cleavers ready to go.  I just need to engrave the names of the students...

english.title: Ride to Ironforge
english.objectives: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Brolan Galebeard, then bring Gremlock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.
english.description: For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge.  From there, deliver Gremlock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe.  You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild.  That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!$B$BSpeak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
english.progress: What can I do for you, $gsir:my lady;?
english.completion: Ah, the latest list of Gremlock's best pupils.  I have a batch of honorary cleavers ready to go.  I just need to engrave the names of the students...

text.title: 向格雷姆罗克回复
text.objectives: 从狮鹫管理员格莱斯·瑟登那里租一头飞往卡拉诺斯的狮鹫，然后将荣誉菜刀交给卡拉诺斯的格雷姆罗克·匹斯诺尔。
text.description: 只要少许费用，你就能租到一只飞往卡拉诺斯的狮鹫……当然，前提是你已经去过卡拉诺斯了。狮鹫只能载着你飞到曾经去过的地方，所以你务必要跟遇到的每个狮鹫管理员交谈，以确保将来你能坐着狮鹫飞到他们那里。$B$B你已经见过卡拉诺斯的狮鹫管理员布洛兰了，所以现在你可以返回他那儿了。到了卡拉诺斯之后，把这些菜刀交给格雷姆罗克·匹斯诺尔。$B$B当你准备出发时就来找我吧。
text.progress: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
text.completion: You brought the cleaver.  Great!  I'll get these to my students.  I'm sure they're eager to use them on some fresh boar meat.$B$BThank you for your help, $N.  I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

english.title: Return to Gremlock
english.objectives: Buy a gryphon to Kharanos from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Cleavers to Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos.
english.description: For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Kharanos... as long as you've already been there.  Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.$B$BYou've already been to Brolan, the gryphon master of Kharanos, so now you can return to him.  And once in Kharanos, you can deliver the cleavers to Gremlock Pilsnor.$B$BSpeak with me when you're ready to go.
english.progress: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
english.completion: You brought the cleaver.  Great!  I'll get these to my students.  I'm sure they're eager to use them on some fresh boar meat.$B$BThank you for your help, $N.  I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

text.title: Elemental War
text.objectives: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.
text.description: The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.$B$B$n, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
text.progress: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
text.completion: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. $N, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.$b$bFor your efforts, I reward you with a choice of my prized possessions.
text.completed: Return to Tsunaman at Sunrock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Thazz'ril's Pick
text.objectives: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
text.description: $n, you are a dependable $r.  Can I count on you for another task?$B$BSome time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?$B$BI left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
text.progress: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, $N? Did you find my pick?
text.completion: Great, you got it! Thanks a lot, $N. This is my favorite pick! Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

text.title: Marla's Last Wish
text.objectives: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
text.description: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.$B$BMarla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband.  So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.$B$BSamuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell.  Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
text.progress: We must respect our dead, $N. It is one of the ways in which we differ from the Scourge...
text.completion: You have done a good deed today, $N. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.
text.completed: Return to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: Kaya's Alive
text.objectives: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.
text.description: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
text.completion: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, $N.

text.title: Stormwind Rendezvous
text.objectives: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
text.description: You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of Stormwind.$B$BWhat Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!$B$BDo not attempt to venture there alone, $n. You must amass an army! Gather your compatriots. To arms!
text.completion: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!

english.completion: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!

text.title: The Great Masquerade
text.objectives: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!
text.description: It has been quite the adventure, friend. I owe you a great debt of gratitude. Perhaps, when all is said and done...$B$BAs you have no doubt ascertained by now, Lady Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian.$B$BFor too long she has held our kingdom in her captivating gaze. Even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery - a puppet. It all ends today... The spell will be broken.$B$BWorry not, for together, we shall be victorious!$B$BAre you ready?
text.progress: I... I... I was powerless.
text.completion: <Bolvar holds the shattered medallion.>$B$BThe magic held within must be reignited. The dragon's eye must be attuned.$B$BWindsor's sacrifice has freed our Kingdom, but the threat of Onyxia and her kin is ever looming.$B$BThis medallion is what held my mind and body captive. It is also what gave me access to Onyxia's own mind - to her secrets. Albeit the visions are muddled now, some things I do remember.

text.title: Boulderslide Ravine
text.objectives: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
text.description: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $n?$B$BSoutheast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.$B$BGo young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
text.progress: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
text.completion: Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The Kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.$b$bLegend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.$b$b<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>$b$bPerhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this Kobold plot.
text.completed: Return to Mor'rogal at Sunrock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 萨特之角
text.objectives: 为碎木哨岗的皮克希尔收集16只萨特的角。
text.description: 你好啊！我要穿越灰谷往棘齿城去，途中在碎木哨岗这里稍作休息。我一直在寻找发财的机会，眼下似乎就有一个——这些日子以来棘齿城的萨特角行情看涨。$B$B在附近询问了一番之后，我认为夜道谷、萨提纳尔和萨维亚的萨特头上的角都符合我的要求。不过我可不是萨特的对手……你也许能行！$B$B帮我收集一些角吧，我会给你报酬的。
text.progress: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
text.completion: These are perfect, $N! Thanks for helping me out!$b$bOh, and this is for your time...
text.completed: Return to Pixel in Splintertree Post

english.title: Satyr Horns
english.objectives: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.
english.description: Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.$B$BAfter asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!$B$BTell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
english.progress: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
english.completion: These are perfect, $N! Thanks for helping me out!$b$bOh, and this is for your time...
english.completed: Return to Pixel in Splintertree Post

text.title: 佐拉姆海岸的纳迦
text.objectives: 将20个怒尾纳迦的徽记交给佐拉姆海岸的玛鲁凯。
text.description: 邪恶的力量正潜伏在海岸边，$c。$B$B海面下长眠着一座在很久以前就被摧毁的城市，佐拉姆城。这座城市差不多都快要被遗忘了。$B$B现在，出于某种未知的原因，纳迦又重新回来了。但是这其中的原因并不重要，重要的是，我们必须为这片土地而战！我们必须保卫经过浴血奋战而得来的领土。$B$B去奋勇杀敌吧，$n，给我带回20个纳迦的徽记来！将它们逼回深海！
text.progress: The naga increase in numbers, $n. Please complete this task for me.
text.completion: We could use more of your kind around here, $N. Thank you for your help.

english.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand
english.objectives: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.
english.description: There is evil lurking here along the coast, $r.$B$BIt is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.$B$BNow, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.$B$BReturn to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
english.progress: The naga increase in numbers, $n. Please complete this task for me.
english.completion: We could use more of your kind around here, $N. Thank you for your help.

text.title: Blood Feeders
text.objectives: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.
text.description: We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.$B$BLately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.$B$BIf you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
text.progress: Hey mon, have you slain the hairy blood feeders? I fear none here in Stonetalon but I don't go walking around here at night... if you know what I mean mon!$b$bAs long as I stay off there dinner plate then all is well.$b$bGood luck to you, $C!
text.completion: Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner gusts tonight.$b$bAs I said earlier, we are in your debt... maybe you would care for one of these for your deed?
text.completed: Return to Xen'Zilla at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 巨魔符咒
text.objectives: 将8个巨魔符咒交给地狱咆哮岗哨的米苏瓦。
text.description: 我的族人携带着大量神圣的巨魔符咒到这里来，但是在他们抵达佐拉姆加之前，蓟皮熊怪袭击了他们，把他们全都给杀了！这些可憎的熊怪！$B$B我思念那些死去的兄弟姐妹，但愿我们能在另一个世界重逢。不过，他们的巨魔符咒蕴含着巨大的价值。这些符咒落在熊怪手里对我们来说简直是一种耻辱！$B$B$n，你必须取回符咒！在阿斯特兰纳北面的蓟皮村的角落里，有一处名叫蓟皮要塞洞穴，符咒就在那些箱子里。
text.progress: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
text.completion: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, $N! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.$b$bA troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...$b$bWorthless.

english.title: Troll Charm
english.objectives: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at Hellscream's Watch.
english.description: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile furbolgs!$B$BI miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their troll charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!$B$B$n, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
english.progress: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
english.completion: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, $N! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.$b$bA troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...$b$bWorthless.

text.title: Earthen Arise
text.objectives: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
text.description: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.$B$BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.$B$BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $n!
text.progress: I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... go now $N!
text.completion: You bear good news, $C! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.$b$bSlaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble $C.$b$bAccept this as your reward most honored one.
text.completed: Return to Mor'rogal at Sunrock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 鲁尔的自由
text.objectives: 护送鲁尔，然后与碎木岗哨的雅玛·雪蹄谈一谈。
text.description: 呃？你是谁？$B$B$n？你不是熊怪，它们是邪恶的生物！它们以为我是一头熊并俘虏了我，现在它们又让我忍饥挨饿！我快要没力气了……$B$B帮我逃离这里，然后到东面的碎木哨岗去找我的妹妹雅玛。$B$B$n！我必须离开这儿！
text.progress: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...
text.completion: You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.$B$BThank you for rescuing my brother, $N.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
text.end: 护送鲁尔逃离蓟皮熊怪的领地。
text.completed: 去灰谷，找碎木岗哨的雅玛·雪蹄。

english.title: Freedom to Ruul
english.objectives: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
english.description: Eh?  Who are you?$B$B$n?  You're no furbolg.  They are cursed!  They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me!  My strength is failing...$B$BHelp me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.$B$B$n! I must escape!
english.progress: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...
english.completion: You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.$B$BThank you for rescuing my brother, $N.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
english.completed: Return to Yama Snowhoof at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: The Dragon's Eye
text.objectives: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.
text.description: A fragment of the shattered medallion is all that I can offer.$B$BYou must find another of dragon blood willing to assist you in forging a new key. Once you secure this key, you must travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. It is there that you will find her lair, $n.$B$BWhere to find other flights willing to help? Sadly, I do not know... They are said to exist. Some may even work and live among us, disguised as one of the humanoid races. I wish you luck.
text.progress: I sense an aura of evil radiating from you, $R. What could you hold that emits such an aura?
text.completion: I should have known - a piece of the black dragon brood mother, Onyxia. How revolting...

text.title: Drakefire Amulet
text.objectives: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
text.description: It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.$B$BIt is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian. Perhaps you have heard of him?$B$BReturn with his blood, $r, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to Onyxia's lair.
text.progress: The flow of time does not stop or slow, $R. While my life is eternal, yours is not. Waste not the time that you have...
text.completion: This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of Onyxia can be found in Dustwallow Marsh. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.$B$BThe Blue Flight wishes you luck, $N.
text.completed: Return to Haleh at The Ruins of Kel'Theril in Winterspring.

text.title: 灰谷先驱者
text.objectives: 杀掉9个灰谷先驱者。
text.description: 该死的精灵！他们对我们的弱点知道得一清二楚！$b$b一定是因为他们的那些先驱者……我早就在警告大家，他们正在对我们进行侦查，但就是没有人听我的。现在看看我的情形——就好象一群被困在这里的小鸡！$b$b现在复仇还不算晚，朋友！消灭那些先驱者，让他们为所作的一切付出代价！
text.progress: I await reports of your outrunner kills, $N.
text.completion: Very good, $N. Your hunting skills are impressive...$b$bThe loss of those outrunners help blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
text.completed: Speak to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Post.

english.title: Ashenvale Outrunners
english.objectives: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners.
english.description: Blasted elves! Dey knew right where to hit us!$b$bIt was dem outrunners... I tried to warn 'em that we were being spied on, but no one listened. Now look at us - cooped up here like chickens!$b$bNever too late for vengeance, mon! Hunt 'em down and make 'em pay for what they done!
english.progress: I await reports of your outrunner kills, $N.
english.completion: Very good, $N. Your hunting skills are impressive...$b$bThe loss of those outrunners help blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
english.completed: Speak to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Post.

text.title: The Lost Pages
text.objectives: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
text.description: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.$B$BThe pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
text.progress: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
text.completion: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!
text.completed: Return to Gurda Ragescar at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: An Unholy Alliance
text.objectives: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.
text.progress: Have you found the Ambassador, $N? Is he dead?$B$BWe cannot afford to allow the Scourge to take a foothold on Kalimdor. They are enough of a threat to our own borders to have to deal with them on two fronts.$B$BThe only optimistic sign from the events you've told me about is that the crone seemed uncorrupted. She must know deep in her spirit that the Scourge may bring great power, but that the Barrens would not truly be hers if she were to agree to their deal.
text.completion: Good. Well done, $C.$B$BNow that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourges advances will be halted. The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.$B$BAlthough we do not know the extent of the Scourges influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

text.title: An Unholy Alliance
text.objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.
text.description: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin
text.progress: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
text.completion: I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.$B$BThe Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.$B$BIf the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

text.title: Protect Kaya
text.objectives: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.
text.description: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.$b$bMy father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
text.completion: Kaya is alive! $N, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
text.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Greatwood Vale in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Report to Kadrak
text.objectives: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in Northern Barrens.
text.description: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.$B$BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
text.completion: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.

text.title: 战歌报告
text.objectives: 打开报告集，把战歌报告交给战歌斥候、战歌信使和战歌侦查骑兵。把他们的最新报告交给贫瘠之地北部哨塔上的卡德拉克。
text.description: 我最近派了一些斥候进入灰谷，所以我得找个跑腿的去把他们的报告带回来。$B$B你的第一站应该是西面的佐拉姆海岸边的佐拉姆加前哨站，在那里可以找到第一个斥候。另外你还要到北边的碎木哨岗去，它就在东边的路上，靠近艾萨拉地区。你可以在那里找到一个斥候和一个侦查骑兵。$B$B给他们每人一份报告，然后把他们的最新报告拿回来。
text.progress: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
text.completion: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
text.completed: Return to Kadrak at The Mor'shan Rampart in The Barrens.

english.title: The Warsong Reports
english.objectives: Open the Bundle of Reports.  Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.
english.description: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.$B$BYour first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.$B$BGive them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
english.progress: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
english.completion: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
english.completed: Return to Kadrak at The Mor'shan Rampart in The Barrens.

text.title: 托雷克的突袭
text.objectives: 保护在银翼哨站与杜瑞尔·月火作战的托雷克，然后向慰籍之林的埃尔托格·怒齿汇报胜利的消息。
text.description: 嘿！$C！到这儿来！$B$B我将和我的部队准备袭击西边的银翼哨站，这次行动的目标是他们的首领杜瑞尔·月火。据侦察，那座哨站中有重兵把守。这将是一场激烈而光荣的战役！$B$B你愿意加入我们的队伍吗，$n？如果你愿意的话，那么当战役结束时，你就可以去将我们胜利的消息汇报给慰藉之林的埃尔托格·怒齿了。$B$B你认为怎么样，要跟我们一起来吗？
text.progress: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?
text.completion: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, $N. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...$b$bAnd I hope you gained a scar or two!
text.completed: 去灰谷找弗伦河的埃尔托格·怒齿。

english.title: Torek's Assault
english.objectives: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
english.description: Hey!  $C!  Come here!$B$BMy raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west.  Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire.  Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors.  The battle will be glorious!$B$BDo you want to share in the glory, $n, and aid us?  If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.$B$BWhat do you say.  Are you with us?
english.progress: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?
english.completion: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, $N. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...$b$bAnd I hope you gained a scar or two!
english.completed: Return to Ertog Ragetusk at Falfarren River in Ashenvale.

text.title: Warsong Runner Update
text.progress: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.$B$BYou'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, $N. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.$B$BBut if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
text.completion: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
text.completed: Return to Warsong Runner in Felwood.

text.title: Warsong Outrider Update
text.progress: Much danger lies along this path, $N. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.$B$BWe are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.$B$BIt's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, $N.
text.completion: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, $N.
text.completed: Return to Warsong Outrider in Azshara.

text.title: Warsong Scout Update
text.progress: Keep an eye out, $R. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...$B$BWe must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.$B$BI assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
text.completion: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
text.completed: Return to Warsong Scout in Ashenvale.

text.title: Avenge My Village
text.objectives: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.
text.description: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.$b$b$n, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
text.progress: Have you killed them yet?
text.completion: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
text.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at the border of the Barrens and Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Blackfathom Villainy
text.objectives: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.$b$bAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $n, please.
text.progress: May the Earthmother be with you, $N.$B$BPeace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
text.completion: Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.$B$BFor some time they considered him dead or missing.$B$BBy ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.$B$BEarthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!$B$BYou have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Bashana Runetotem at The Golden Plains in Mulgore.

english.objectives: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.$b$bAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $n, please.

text.title: Trouble in the Deeps
text.objectives: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
text.description: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He waits just inside Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $n. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
text.completion: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.

text.title: 阿库麦尔水晶
text.objectives: 收集20颗阿库麦尔蓝宝石，把它们交给灰谷的耶努萨克雷。
text.description: 在通往黑暗深渊入口的通道中有许多生长在洞穴墙壁上的蓝宝石，最近有消息说纳迦正在挖掘这些宝石。在搞清楚他们的动机之前，我们应该先阻止它们。这些水晶中蕴含着强大的元素力量，只要经过一定的处理，它们就可以被制作成强大的魔法材料。$B$B你能帮帮我吗，$n？从我们的哨所往北走，然后就可以在佐拉姆海岸附近找到黑暗深渊了。
text.progress: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
text.completion: Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguings...$B$BI can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
text.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

english.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai
english.objectives: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
english.description: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.$B$BWill you help me, $n? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
english.progress: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
english.completion: Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguings...$B$BI can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
english.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

text.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods
text.objectives: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
text.description: Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:$B$B"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.$B$BBy controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
text.progress: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
text.completion: This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.$b$bNow we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.

text.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods
text.objectives: Kill Lorgus Jett.
text.description: This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $n. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.$B$BGo into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here.
text.progress: Have you found him yet, $N? Lorgus must be stopped!
text.completion: Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.$b$bWho knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
text.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea.

text.objectives: Listen to Thrall.
text.description: It is good to see you again, $n. The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom.$B$BSit, listen.
text.progress: Patience, $N. Pay attention!
text.completion: Are you prepared to take on this task?
text.completed: Return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

text.title: The Champion of the Horde
text.objectives: Seek out Rokaro at Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
text.description: Rexxar, one of my most loyal champions, has discovered a way into the lair of the dragon. However he has left Azeroth to join our expedition into Outland.$b$bHowever, he left his companion, Rokaro, in Shadowprey Village with this information. You are to seek him out.
text.completion: There is but one way into the dragon's lair, $R.$B$BYou see, only the strongest of the Black Dragonflight are allowed entry into the lair of the brood mother. Many trials must be passed and the key to enter ceremoniously enchanted by General Drakkisath himself!$B$BSince you are not of black dragonkin, you may have some difficulty in obtaining passage.$B$B<Rexxar grins.>

text.title: Mistress of Deception
text.objectives: Deliver Rokaro's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
text.description: Illusion and disguise. That is how you will fool the Black Dragonflight, and gain what you seek.$b$bThough I could teach you something of the skills of deception, you need the help of a master.$b$bI know of one who could do this. In the Western Plaguelands, you will find Myranda the Hag, once a master illusionist of Lordaeron. She has helped us in the past, and if she believes the cause worthy, she may help you.$b$bTake this message to her.
text.progress: It is not often I see one of the Horde in these parts of Lordaeron. What is it that you have for Myranda?
text.completion: <Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles.>$B$BHow is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!$B$BOh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, $R. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.$B$B<Myranda smiles.>

text.title: Oculus Illusions
text.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
text.description: So the $r wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?$B$BThe creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. The Warchief has entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.$B$BTravel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.$B$BReturn to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
text.progress: The eyes of that which we wish to mimic are the most important ingredient of any illusion, $N.$B$B<Myranda points to a bag almost overflowing with eyeballs labeled 'Scarlet Crusade.'>$B$B<Myranda laughs.>
text.completion: Let Myranda have a look, $R.$B$BOh yes, these will do nicely.$B$BWith these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
text.completed: Return to Myranda the Hag at Sorrow Hill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: Emberstrife
text.objectives: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.
text.description: I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.$B$BEmberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of Nefarian, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to Onyxia.$B$BTravel to the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh and enter the lair of Emberstrife. Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!
text.completion: Have we run so low on able soldiers that Nefarian is sending me whelps? You will never pass my tests, broodling.

text.title: Warsong Supplies
text.objectives: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.
text.description: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!$B$BPixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.$B$BOur shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!$B$BCan you help me?
text.progress: I hope you can come through with the supplies!
text.completion: Excellent, $N. You've saved me a lot of work!$b$bBut don't think that I'm not grateful!

text.title: Warsong Saw Blades
text.progress: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.$B$B..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!$B$BWhat I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.$B$BSo, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
text.completion: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.

text.title: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
text.objectives: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.$B$BYou know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
text.description: We are Deathwing's children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.$B$BIf you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.$B$BFind their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!$B$BTravel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.
text.progress: <Emberstrife hisses.>
text.completion: One of ssseveral complete...
text.completed: Return to Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: Ascension...
text.objectives: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rokaro and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
text.description: From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.$B$BTake it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.$B$BYou will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.$B$BGo!
text.progress: Do not panic, $N!
text.completion: It is merely dragon-talk, $N - more hot air than actual substantive information. Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.

english.title: Ascension...
english.objectives: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rokaro and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.
english.description: From the skulls of our enemies is shaped a medallion. You know this medallion, yesss? You have no doubt seen it worn by your elders.$B$BTake it, whelp. Return to the Spire and present it to General Drakkisath. The General will place the final enchantment upon the medallion, attuning the trinket to your spirit.$B$BYou will wear the finished medallion as a badge of honor, symbolizing your ascension to one of our most guarded ranks: Guardian to the brood mother.$B$BGo!
english.progress: Do not panic, $N!
english.completion: It is merely dragon-talk, $N - more hot air than actual substantive information. Pompous, aggressive behavior is to be expected from their kind.

text.title: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
text.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rokaro.
text.description: How would you feel about paying a visit to the General? No illusions, this time.$b$bCeremony? A pretty word to describe the bloodletting that amuses the Black Dragonflight.$b$bAll this amulet requires is the blood of General Drakkisath. Primitive security. There are other ways to receive the General's blood.$b$bGo to Blackrock Spire and kill Drakkisath. Return with his blood and I will activate the key to Onyxia's lair.
text.progress: I don't think I need to tell you that Drakkisath is not to be taken lightly.$B$BI let the thousands dead by his hand do the talking.
text.completion: A victory that will be remembered for many years, $N. The Drakefire Amulet will open Onyxia's lair. Gather your allies and bring victory to the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Rokaro at Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

text.title: Trouble in Winterspring!
text.objectives: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.
text.description: There's trouble in Winterspring!$B$BWhy, sure, I spend some time out in the wilds and know about these things... I'm always mighty proud to say it. I consider the hours I spend out there in the hills to be golden. Help you cultivate quick reflexes, a cool head and a keen eye...$B$BIt takes judgement, brains and maturity to appreciate the wilderness in the way that I do.$B$BNow, what was I talking about?$B$BAh yes, trouble. See Donova Snowden at the hot springs and she can tell you more.
text.completion: Well, hi there! So Meggi told you of the trouble I have found here?

text.title: Enraged Wildkin
text.objectives: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.
text.description: Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!$B$BI heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. I'm sure curious about what happened... aren't you?
text.completion: Aye, what can I do for you?

text.title: A Strange One
text.objectives: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.
text.description: I just got back from Felwood, $n. On my way through, I stopped at Bloodvenom Post and I met a very odd character... She seemed intent on one thing, and I suppose I could tell you what that is, but I think she'd like to explain it to you herself.$B$BIf you're interested, head to Bloodvenom Post in western Felwood and look for Winna Hazzard.$B$BWho knows, she might need your help...
text.completion: Ah, $C. I see that there is hope yet. Are you here to assist me?

text.title: A Little Luck
text.objectives: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
text.description: We can always use a little luck, eh? A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor...$B$BI happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. She made me a lucky charm... for a price. Believe me, though, it was well worth it!$B$BMaybe you'd be interested in one of your own? Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook. I'm not giving mine up!
text.completion: Ah, so Harlo be sendin' you? Well, den, who might you be? I s'pose you be wantin' my help?
